domains.name: Levels & XP
domains.promise: Members earn XP for genuine message and voice activity under anti-spam cooldowns, see their standing on branded rank cards and leaderboards, and unlock owner-configured level reward roles driven by an owner-tunable curve and multipliers.

Whether members earn XP for time spent active in voice channels.
XP granted per completed voice interval.

Channel scoping for message XP: every channel, only listed channels, or every channel except listed ones.
Channel ids interpreted per xp-channel-mode.
Role whose holders never earn XP; empty string disables the exclusion.
How overlapping role or channel multipliers combine: highest single multiplier wins, or all multipliers stack.

controls.description: List of level reward bindings, each mapping a level number to a role id with an announce flag.

defaults.rationale: Levels reward genuine activity out of the box; visible status is core to the community experience.
Industry-familiar floor that makes every genuine message feel worthwhile.

Steady voice accrual roughly comparable to relaxed chatting.

Rich open default: every channel counts until the owner scopes it.
No channels scoped until the owner opts in to allowlist or denylist mode.
No exclusion role until the owner assigns one.
Highest-wins is the least surprising combination rule and prevents runaway stacking.
Gentle early levels for quick wins, meaningful grind at high levels; fully owner-tunable.
No reward roles until the owner defines them; announcements activate per binding.
